verdict.rationale: Missive's docs say you can connect Gmail, Outlook, Exchange, iCloud, or IMAP accounts, with full two-way Gmail sync including labels and IMAP/SMTP support even for servers with untrusted certificates. Its unified inbox manages email, SMS, WhatsApp and more in one place. Missing for 10: explicit naming of Microsoft 365 (only Outlook/Exchange are named), in-depth docs on running several accounts together in one unified view, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place
